text.title: Semantic Xml Content Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable input signals to a conclusion referencing a rule from 01-core-rules.xml: applicability first, then the kind of block being tagged.

decision-tree.root-question: Do ALL Applies-If conditions hold AND NO Skip-If condition triggers?

branch.question: What is the block being tagged?

conclusion.verdict: put it in an attribute, not a child element.

branch.when: block_kind == 'source code or text containing angle brackets or ampersands'

conclusion.verdict: wrap in code lang with CDATA; escape entities elsewhere.

branch.when: block_kind == 'link to a consumed file or related reading'

conclusion.verdict: reference for a consumed file, see-also for optional context.
delete the tag; keep the content.
reuse the nearest glossary tag or propose a glossary update first.
apply the methodology; produce the artefact and validate it.
preconditions not met; route to the correct methodology or skip.
